description: Aggregate social sentiment for any crypto token or topic. Returns an overall 0-100 bullish score, per-source breakdown (market, community, social), mention volume, and confidence level. Sources: Alternative.me Fear & Greed (market), CoinGecko community votes, and StockGeist social media analysis (when STOCKGEIST_API_KEY is configured). Costs $0.005 USDC per call.
name: crypto_sentiment
title: Crypto sentiment
